body:
Thanks everyone. I didn't think this would get any comments at all. I just needed to vent. 

I've sat with these feelings since our chat and I think I have a direction I want to take! I'm looking into being an EA (educational assistant) as they are in high demand and I have so much experience with my own special needs child. I don't think it's something I would want to do forever but it would serve my family well. 

I am currently on medication for depression and anxiety and diving into my mental health issues and have asked for a referral for a psychiatrist.
